Subject: Request: executive concession for Hosted API - Aurelia Health pilot (25% off)

Hi Mina,

Aurelia Health (Sara Li, procurement) is asking for a 25% concession off our Hosted API list rates for a 6-month pilot that could convert to an annual contract with meaningful volume growth. Key bullets:
- Pilot: 6 months, expected token run-rate ~120M tokens/month by month 3
- Requested concession: 25% off list for pilot months; they may ask to extend to first 12 months if conversion
- Rationale: strategic healthcare reference, potential for multi-region expansion, immediate PoC with a tight timeline
- Ask: Exec sign-off for 25% off for pilot, conditional on: 1) a minimum 6-month prepaid commitment or 2) a signed MSA and case study agreement if they convert to annual within 90 days

I attached the usage forecast and draft SOW. Forecast shows we still land acceptable unit economics at 25% if we secure a prepaid minimum/commitment. If we only get month-to-month with no visibility, margin is too thin.

Can you review and route to Ben/Marissa for an approval? SLA and legal redlines are minimal; they accept our standard SOC2/KMS terms.

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Account Exec, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Aurelia_usage_forecast_Q3-Q4.xlsx, SOW_Aurelia_Pilot_v1.docx
From: Mina Haddad <mina.h@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.c@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.c@redwood.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.b@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: executive concession for Hosted API - Aurelia Health pilot (25% off)

Team — forwarding Dylan's note. Quick summary and my take:
- Strategic: Aurelia is a high-value healthcare customer with strong referral potential in the regional hospital network.
- Financial: Forecasted 120M tokens/mo pushes them into enterprise volume band; blended unit economics at 25% concession still acceptable with a 6-month prepaid guarantee.
- Risk: if they go month-to-month, downside is significant. Recommend conditioning approval on either a 6-month prepay or a signed conversion SLA that includes a marketing/case-study commitment.

Please advise if we can approve 25% on the pilot with those conditions. If yes, we need to confirm the exact language for the SOW and update the pricing sheet.

Mina Haddad
Sales Manager, US East

Thanks for the context — reviewed the forecast and SOW. I authorize a 25% Hosted API list discount for the Aurelia Health pilot under the following conditions:
1) They sign the SOW and prepay the agreed pilot amount (minimum 6 months' commitment reflected in the attached SOW) OR provide a corporate PO committing to a 6-month spend.
2) Redwood receives rights to publish a customer case study and logo use upon pilot completion or conversion (standard marketing agreement).
3) Legal to perform a quick review; no non-standard IP or data residency asks permitted beyond our standard Private/Hosted controls.

Operational notes for contracting: please add a one-line clause that the discount applies to Hosted API list rates for the pilot term only and will be re-evaluated at conversion. If they convert to an annual committed contract within 90 days of pilot completion, we will negotiate a renewal discount consistent with then-current volume bands (not automatically extend the 25%).

Approve: 25% concession for pilot (conditional). Please confirm and initiate DocuSign.

Ben Carter
VP, Sales Operations
